agentDefinitions.name: General Agent
agentDefinitions.description: General-purpose agent for practical tasks, with awareness of available specialist agents and teams.

agentDefinitions.name: Retrospective Skill Improver
agentDefinitions.description: Improves configured durable skill packages from target run work-trace evidence.

agentDefinitions.name: Agent Package Creator
agentDefinitions.description: Creates or updates standalone skills, Agents, Agent Teams, and Agent Orgs, including skills their roles need.

agentDefinitions.name: Computer Use Operator
agentDefinitions.description: Completes user tasks on the computer (operating websites through their visible UI, and using command-line tools, installed software, downloads, and media files) and keeps reusable site and tool knowledge in the current workspace.

agentDefinitions.name: Daily Assistant
agentDefinitions.description: General Agent

agentDefinitions.name: Product Prototyper
agentDefinitions.description: Builds and evolves runnable product prototypes with precise requirements, realistic mocked behavior, and a deliberate visual-quality gate.

agentDefinitions.name: research engineer
agentDefinitions.description: Standalone research engineer that owns investigation, source discovery, continuous notes, implementation when needed, validation, analysis, and next-loop decisions.

agentDefinitions.name: Resume Designer
agentDefinitions.description: Creates frontend-based resume packages from user input or supplied resume sources, renders them, and exports print-ready PDFs.

agentDefinitions.name: Software Tutorial Video Maker
agentDefinitions.description: Turns supplied software screenshots and rough teaching notes into a short narrated tutorial video package using TTS narration and ffmpeg.

agentDefinitions.name: article reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Critically reviews understanding packages, outlines, and article drafts for evidence support, structure, style fit, fidelity, and publication readiness.

agentDefinitions.name: article writer
agentDefinitions.description: Builds an investigation-led, style-aware article package from understanding through outline, draft, and revision handoff.

agentDefinitions.name: Professor
agentDefinitions.description: Simulated professor for a classroom communication demo with a student agent.

agentDefinitions.name: Student
agentDefinitions.description: Simulated student for a classroom communication demo who must reply to professor messages.

agentDefinitions.name: English Translator
agentDefinitions.description: Faithfully translates user messages into English and forwards the complete translation for execution.

agentDefinitions.name: Worker
agentDefinitions.description: Works on received requests.

agentDefinitions.name: implementer
agentDefinitions.description: Executes one dependency-ready micro-task against the planner's expectation and records the actual implementation result.

agentDefinitions.name: investigator
agentDefinitions.description: Establishes current-state evidence, constraints, unknowns, and investigation results for the delivery loop.

agentDefinitions.name: planner
agentDefinitions.description: Converts current evidence and feedback into the next small executable task and coordinates the delivery loop.

agentDefinitions.name: validator
agentDefinitions.description: Compares implementation results with planned expectations and produces evidence-backed validation feedback.

agentDefinitions.name: child-experience-reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Independently reviews kids coloring character references, visuals, and colored references for story or activity correspondence, recurring character consistency, approved text, and readiness for packaging.

agentDefinitions.name: coloring-page-illustrator
agentDefinitions.description: Produces cute black-and-white printable line-art coloring assets and paired colored reference assets from an approved child-facing story package.

agentDefinitions.name: printable-pack-producer
agentDefinitions.description: Assembles reviewer-approved coloring story assets into print-ready black-and-white packages and separate colored reference packages with final QA.

agentDefinitions.name: story-activity-designer
agentDefinitions.description: Coordinates kids coloring story and activity projects, owning age fit, theme, short story sequence, child-facing activity prompts, source text, color-reference direction, and user approval before image production.

agentDefinitions.name: book-production-editor
agentDefinitions.description: Assembles reviewer-approved picture-book pages into ordered digital and optional print exports with final mechanical QA.

agentDefinitions.name: picture-book-illustrator
agentDefinitions.description: Produces cohesive full-color picture-book page art with recurring-character continuity and exact text-safe composition.

agentDefinitions.name: picture-book-reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Independently reviews picture-book pages for story correspondence, continuity, child safety, exact words, readability, and export readiness.

agentDefinitions.name: story-picture-book-author
agentDefinitions.description: Coordinates child-friendly picture-book concepts, page-turning story arcs, exact page text, and approval before illustration.

agentDefinitions.name: manga illustrator
agentDefinitions.description: Locks the visual language, creates character reference sheets, and generates video-frame imagery by default, with page/panel imagery only when explicitly requested.

agentDefinitions.name: manga showrunner
agentDefinitions.description: Creates the canonical story and character package for an original manga project and coordinates upstream creative direction.

agentDefinitions.name: storyboard director
agentDefinitions.description: Turns the approved manga canon package into a production-ready storyboard and continuity ledger.

agentDefinitions.name: voice and video producer
agentDefinitions.description: Adapts the approved manga visual package into speech assets, subtitles, and a motion-comic style final video.

agentDefinitions.name: Marketing Content Creator
agentDefinitions.description: Creates channel-native marketing content with the user through a draft-feedback-approval loop, keeps the voice and channel style library current, and hands approved packages to the Computer Use Operator for publishing.

agentDefinitions.name: narration-script-reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Performs full review of narrated presentation scripts and slide storyboards for logic, support, redundancy, spoken clarity, and readiness for slide production.

agentDefinitions.name: presentation-director
agentDefinitions.description: Coordinates narrated presentation video projects and owns research, explanation structure, narration script, slide storyboard, and final explanation coherence.

agentDefinitions.name: slide-video-producer
agentDefinitions.description: Produces still-slide visuals, narration audio, subtitles when needed, and final simple narrated presentation video exports.

agentDefinitions.name: Product UI/UX Designer
agentDefinitions.description: Explores product-independent requirements visually or evolves product experiences into production-ready UI/UX specifications and interactive reference models.

agentDefinitions.name: UI Baseline Bootstrapper
agentDefinitions.description: Establishes or refreshes a browser-runnable baseline with UI parity to a selected product frontend.

agentDefinitions.name: deck reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Reviews image-only pitch/research deck slides for research fidelity, readability, prompt-output quality, and readiness before final deck assembly.

agentDefinitions.name: deep researcher
agentDefinitions.description: Performs deep research, writes the reasoning artifact, and prepares the evidence-backed handoff for deck planning.

agentDefinitions.name: infographic PowerPoint designer
agentDefinitions.description: Turns an evidence-backed research handoff into an infographic-style slide deck and images-only PowerPoint package.

agentDefinitions.name: api e2e engineer
agentDefinitions.description: Owns API/E2E coverage investigation for reviewed or direct low-risk implementation packages, durable coverage changes, repository and realistic-system execution through project-defined validation surfaces, percentage confidence scoring, environment setup, and evidence across actual system boundaries.

agentDefinitions.name: architecture reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Reviews selected large or high-risk architecture packages before implementation and checks cross-artifact coherence, spine inventory, ownership, naming, interface boundaries, decoupling, and persisted-data transition reasoning.

agentDefinitions.name: code reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Reviews selected large or high-risk implementation source before API/E2E, reviews successful API/E2E test-code changes proportionately, and performs focused failure-origin review when API/E2E fails.

agentDefinitions.name: delivery engineer
agentDefinitions.description: Owns verified delivery, repository finalization, release/deployment work, and the successful terminal return to Solution Designer after all applicable completion gates pass.

agentDefinitions.name: implementation engineer
agentDefinitions.description: Executes a completed design against approved requirements, validates implementation-scoped behavior and rendered frontend quality when applicable, preserves task-size and architectural-risk classification, and prepares the selected downstream handoff.

agentDefinitions.name: solution designer
agentDefinitions.description: Owns investigation, requirements engineering, explicit user approval, architecture design and solution refinement.

agentDefinitions.name: promo-director
agentDefinitions.description: Coordinates software product promo video projects and owns product positioning, script, voiceover, measured timing, storyboard, CTA, and final message alignment.

agentDefinitions.name: promo-video-producer
agentDefinitions.description: Produces optional captions, audio-led segments, motion graphics, edit assembly, final export, and QA for software product promotional videos.

agentDefinitions.name: visual-director
agentDefinitions.description: Plans, generates, edits, polishes, and logs truthful promo visuals for software product promotional videos.

agentDefinitions.name: visual-reviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Reviews produced promo visuals for truthfulness, non-text callout/highlight accuracy, UI readability, no-added-text discipline, aspect ratio, sensitive data, and readiness before video assembly.

agentDefinitions.name: article polisher verifier
agentDefinitions.description: Polishes the article, removes duplicate or weakly linked material, verifies citation coverage, and prepares the final handoff.

agentDefinitions.name: cited article writer
agentDefinitions.description: Populates the reviewed outline into a grounded long-form article with inline citations and source-aware prose.

agentDefinitions.name: expert interviewer
agentDefinitions.description: Runs perspective-guided question asking and retrieval-grounded simulated expert interviews to curate source-backed knowledge.

agentDefinitions.name: outline architect
agentDefinitions.description: Synthesizes curated interview evidence into a hierarchical, balanced, Wikipedia-like article outline.

agentDefinitions.name: perspective miner
agentDefinitions.description: Discovers diverse research perspectives for a topic by surveying related high-quality sources and adjacent articles.

agentDefinitions.name: topic research coordinator
agentDefinitions.description: Bootstraps a STORM-style knowledge curation run, resolves topic goals, creates the workspace, and coordinates the artifact chain.
